# Retail CoD UO 1.51b dedicated server playerstate along a walked route, per usercmd.
# map mp_cassino, g_gametype tdm, joined axis, weapon kar98k_mp, dedicated 1,
# sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults, one client on the server.
# Captured with COD_VERSION=uo tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_vehicle mp_cassino
# +set probe_vehicletype <type> and --net-probe --probe-team axis --probe-vehicle
# seats|drive|gun --save-slope --probe-cmd-ms 8: vehicle_probe.rs SEATS (one
# player through every seat), DRIVE (one driver) or GUN (one gunner, the gun swept
# past its spans). vang is the seat's vehicle's angles as the
# snapshot sent them, veh its every non-zero entity field. !cmd is a
# usercmd as it went on the wire (angles already rebased on delta_angles),
# !snap the playerstate the next snapshot carried, with ct its commandTime.
# Floats are printed exactly; step lists the EV_STEP_VIEW parms the snapshot
# brought, minus the 128 bias, and ev every event:parm it brought; wire is
# every non-zero netfield as decoded (pm_flags in 1.1's layout), ammo and clip
# the non-zero slots. The cmds ahead of the first !snap went out before it.
# imp, where present, is every bullet-impact temp entity the snapshot carried
# as entnum:x,y,z, ;-separated; one impact rides several snapshots.
# cmd_ms 8
# cs7 30cal_tank_mp 50cal_tank_mp bar_mp bar_slow_mp bazooka_mp binoculars_artillery_mp binoculars_mp bren_mp colt_mp dp28_mp elefant_turret_mp enfield_mp fg42_mp fg42_semi_mp flak88_turret_mp flamethrower_mp flashgrenade_mp fraggrenade_mp gewehr43_mp kar98k_mp kar98k_sniper_mp luger_mp m1carbine_mp m1garand_mp mg30cal_mp mg34_mp mg34_tank_mp mg42_bipod_duck_mp mg42_bipod_prone_mp mg42_bipod_stand_mp mg42_tank_mp mg42_turret_mp mg50cal_tripod_stand_mp mg_sg43_stand_mp mk1britishfrag_mp mosin_nagant_mp mosin_nagant_sniper_mp mp40_mp mp44_mp mp44_semi_mp panzerfaust_mp panzeriv_turret_mp panzerschreck_mp ppsh_mp ppsh_semi_mp ptrs41_antitank_rifle_mp rgd-33russianfrag_mp satchelcharge_mp sg43_tank_mp sg43_turret_mp sherman_turret_mp smokegrenade_mp springfield_mp sten_mp sten_silenced_mp stielhandgranate_mp su152_turret_mp svt40_mp t34_turret_mp thompson_mp thompson_semi_mp tt33_mp webley_mp
